propositions: The compact.py module is 798 LOC with cyclomatic complexity peaks of 24 and 21, bundling transaction, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI concerns in a single god module.
The split requires two new modules (compact_txn.py for transaction and shared snapshot primitives; compact_rebuild.py for reconstruction) connected acyclically to avoid circular imports.

The counter _REBUILD_COUNT and its accessor get_rebuild_count must colocate with rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log to ensure they read the same module global when the function does `global _REBUILD_COUNT`.
Public and test import paths must be preserved via re-exports from compact.py; two test monkeypatch seams in test_compact_negative.py must be repointed to the symbols' new homes in compact_txn.py.
Complexity baseline entries for the original functions must shrink or be removed; post-split every function must fall below the reporting threshold.

The acceptance criteria require compact.py <= 500 LOC, both new modules >= 100 LOC, zero increased complexity entries, and a new test proving the counter increments across rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log calls.
